notes.text:
The requested whole-audit verdict is INCONCLUSIVE. No concrete material mathematical defect was found in the 13 numbered units, their mathematical applications, or the substantive claims of the five exact native206 FINAL notes. However, the bound inputs omit the actual 291 collar positions, author checker/input, build/preservation/normalization programs, and 73 artifact files underlying historical execution and hash assertions. Those assertions cannot be independently certified from their flags. They are not mathematical grants and are not essential dependencies of the reconstructed continuum arguments.

All 30 delimited bodies were directly read from local input.json in complete bounded chunks, including the entire 1016-LF TeX, separate 290-LF Markdown, 47-LF ledger, 13-LF material record, five exact FINAL notes, ROOT records, old FAIL records, and whole A224/B225/R230/S262 grants with every clarification. Earlier favorable reviews were treated as data. The four original primary bindings independently matched their supplied sizes and hashes. Complete immediate BMPS and BBGS units were read from original text. Independent PDF interpretation of BMPS p.15 and BBGS PDF p.12, printed p.1642, checked rational endpoints and oriented perpendiculars. This does not claim reading every source page or every recursive bibliographic foundation. Early reader headers counted form feeds as lines; final LF coverage was corrected from exact character offsets, without losing read coverage.

Raw calibration is valid at every recursive dimension. Saturation makes a facet basis followed by a primitive inward quotient lift a cell-lattice basis, giving perpendicular height a_sigma/a_tau. Euclidean weights a_sigma c_sigma balance. Subtracting an ambient extension of the face derivative cancels tangent components by continuity and the extension by balance, giving B_-f(ac)(tau)=a_tau D_f c(tau). This repeats through dimensions d,...,1, including signed and zero weights, with a_vertex=1. Whole BBGS 3.12 supplies all three subdivision cases; whole 3.15 supplies commutation through symmetric diagonal and paired cross terms in the codimension-two quotient wedge. Lemma 3.18 and Proposition 3.19 preserve balancing. The latter's printed reference to 3.12 uses the commutation equality of 3.15, as already disclosed. No delegated AR10 commutation, Alexandrov proxy, unsaturated normal or appended factorial is used. PA supports establish positivity before extension.

Finite bounded one-cycle IBP has contribution -w Delta b Delta c/L on each bounded primitive edge. Bounded affine differences have zero slopes on unbounded common-carrier edges. Degree cancellation and replacement of each relative factor by the actual gamma give exact common mass M; bounded IBP gives identity (4). No unrestricted unbounded-test identity is imported. Recession derivatives and constant-outside-compact auxiliary differences are accounted for.

The fixed-carrier PC cone is rational. Shared-face equations test rational affine bases, including constants. Every face retains incident-cone assignments and both tangent/lineality signs. Rational-endpoint PCCs permit real nonnegative relation coefficients. Independent-column elimination proves closedness; separation produces ambient supports. Extreme positive kernel relations have rational generators and support at most rank(U)+1, and support reduction decomposes all relations. Fixed face germs provide supports at arbitrary real centers. Local supports imply contained-segment convexity and every PCC on every rational carrier. Pointed rational recession tests and vertex-plus-recession decomposition give coercivity. Actual real weights and coefficients are never identified with rational geometry.

The exact active PC face supplies the correct rational subspace. Rational density there retains all active costs exactly zero and inactive PC/growth costs strictly positive. Choosing rational gamma0 and sufficiently small rational epsilon gives gamma'=gamma-epsilon gamma0 PC and positive-growth on the same geometry, without replacing gamma. Separately, a rational simplex inside that minimal face's strict neighborhood contains gamma in its interior. Its positive actual barycentric coefficients sum to one and recover all finite coefficients, including constants and affine lineality. The zero-dimensional case uses one rational point. This decomposition concerns reference coefficients only, not arbitrary continuous endpoints.

Compact-test DC auxiliaries are built relative to rational gamma0. Rational wall forms, a sufficiently large bend-dominating constant, a slow rational scale and a raised rational constant produce h0,h1 with supports at boundaries and ties, rational carriers and compact differences. The sums theta_l=gamma'+epsilon h_l are genuine same-actual-reference functions without irrational equality walls. Positive mass-M mixed products give the estimate 2M/(epsilon eta_psi) for every finite tuple, then every completed tuple. Rational norm bumps give controlled-support C_c density; no C_b density is asserted.

The legitimate height is H0=gamma0+c. Cutoffs q_j=max(gamma0-j,-c) and Theta_j=gamma'+epsilon q_j have rational carriers and exact gap epsilon min(H0,j). The older checklist j+c was a task typo, not a repair of the unchanged paper. Finite IBP costs at most 2CM per replaced factor between positive mass-M products. Monotone truncation proves integral H0 MA(a)<=K_C,0=(2d/epsilon)CM+J0 before tightness or C_b convergence. Approximation bounds C+o(1) pass compact height tests and exhaustion, retaining this exact constant for every completed tuple in the entire fixed-C family.

Completion admits only actual uniform/decreasing relative REAL PA approximants. Compact-test estimates, density and the exact granted S262 positive-functional representation premise produce a unique positive Radon limit. A convergent approximation family has a common relative bound; proper-height tails recover exact mass before all-C_b convergence. Comparison gives independence. Finite symmetry and localized compact tests give symmetry and locality. Errors 2^-n with rational shifts 4*2^-n give genuine decreasing extraction. M=0 is separately the zero operator. Global uniform continuity is vague only. Weak C_b and BL uniformity require each fixed C; finite nets concern restrictions of actual global BL tests to one compact cutoff support. Radius-one neighborhoods prove ordinary weak continuity, including nets. Corollary 9 retains actual envelope-domain membership as an antecedent; R230 continuity does not prove higher-dimensional PA approximation.

Theorem 10 successfully preserves arbitrary-reference flat jets. The exact convex reference decomposition permits common rational norm and C,alpha,r,t,delta. Every rational G_i has the same germ C+t+delta h. The inequalities delta|h|<=alpha rho/2 and t<alpha r/4 give an unchanged collar; supports at active entries, ties and gluing boundaries establish PC. All walls and the common finite refinement are rational. F=sum t_i G_i is actual relative REAL PA, and sum t_i=1 preserves the germ exactly. Its primitive atom is delta^d m0(h), and flat costs scale by delta. No residual gamma' germ is added. A real bad jet has a rational extreme zero-cost relation. Rational approximation inside all active rational equalities preserves every face inequality and strict positive raw polynomial mass with actual real weights unchanged. This realizes a rational replacement, not the original irrational coefficients.

Proposition 11 correctly requires PC. Nonnegative costs and B225 positive spanning yield a nonempty compact normalized relation section; nonflatness gives a positive minimum and separation gives a strict floor. A finite actual envelope is PC by supremum Jensen. At a noncontact vertex, a raised affine maximum beneath the continuous obstacle agrees on an unchanged collar and preserves growth. Its possibly irrational walls are permitted for this unrestricted competitor, which receives no measure.

Proposition 12 uses the actual F and a rational norm roof excluding every other genuine vertex. Rational boundary directions with real nonnegative relation weights force q(v)<=F(v) for every printed-PC competitor. Rational radial chords and shrinking rational simplices in minimal relative faces extend q<=F to all real centers without continuity of q. Only after the unrestricted envelope is exactly the genuine PA F is its raw measure used. Artificial atoms vanish and contact is exactly -R m_v.

Both directions of Theorem 13 therefore hold for every actual real positive-growth reference in the finite-PA measured sector. Every rational point and every finite rational tangent-star refinement remain quantified. Rational bad jets suffice. No finite fan-list reduction, higher-dimensional graph weight-ray criterion or non-PA sufficient-contact theorem follows. This condition is necessary for the original universal property, sufficient here only for finite PA measured endpoints.

All five exact FINAL notes retain these mathematical restrictions. Their historical build/checker/hash sentences remain unverified observations. The literal integral-slope/rational-constant category, embedded noncompactness, dimension-zero facts and abstract compact charts retain their separate granted hypotheses. The old 196/200 FAILs are unchanged data, not additional grants. Original P05.2 remains open: higher-dimensional all-obstacle regularization, contact sufficiency for non-PA endpoints and structural treatment of all rational refinements are missing.

Corrected same-reference diamond cutoffs at j=1,2,3,8 give origin 8(A-1)(B-1), each horizontal vertex 4B-2, each vertical vertex 4A-2, total 8AB, height 8j(A+B-1), below 32jAB. Both axis endpoint contributions and balances are retained; no extra factorial appears.

The plane simplex (1,1),(2,1),(1,3) and U34 simplex (1,1),(3,1),(1,3) have intentionally different exact positive coefficients. Each sums to one and recovers A,B.

All 385 origin supports of size at most four were independently enumerated: 14 positive circuits and one flat eta circuit. Four singleton, six pair and twelve top-face germs include tangent signs and assigned slopes; each has two circuits. All 12 fine cones have saturated index one. Primitive eta first weights balance and give raw atom four. Scaling by delta=1/64 gives 1/1024. The continuum estimate eta,h<=2rho and common alpha=1/16,r=1/4,t=1/512 give collar margin 1/512 independently of any sampled grid.

Only the historical count 291 is supplied; the actual positions and author checker/input are absent. No invented point list is represented as that run. Historical build/preservation programs, PDFs/logs and 73 artifact files are also absent. Their flags cannot independently establish execution or hashes.
